column7: second consequence of the same #2700 primitive: the full-row Save also reverted rotation_state/last_rotation_error/last_state_at, which belong to UpdateRotationState (the rotation executor) -- so an ordinary policy edit erased a recorded rotation FAILURE, hiding it from the posture view that reads those columns. Closed by excluding those three columns from UpdateRotationPolicyFields entirely. Red on real Postgres: rotation_state was back to "idle" and last_rotation_error empty after an executor stamp that reported success
